architectural_locks.engine: heart-sort.ts is SSOT. Source: /Users/ramchitturi/algo/src/engine/heart-sort.ts. Full port complete (DecisionItem, calculateWeightedScore, addReaction, removeReaction, calculateAgreementScore, getRankedSummary).
architectural_locks.infrastructure: Hybrid Stack: Firebase Auth (OTP), Supabase Postgres (decision engine + E2EE key distribution + encrypted message storage), Firebase Storage (E2EE multimedia + encrypted key backups), Firebase FCM (push), Gemini 2.5 Flash (intelligence). Signal Protocol E2EE ENABLED (Double Ratchet 1:1 + Sender Keys groups). Encrypted IndexedDB store (src/lib/crypto/encrypted-store.ts). Two-phase ratchet commit (encrypt → persist → send). Decrypt mutex prevents concurrent ratchet corruption. Sender Key recovery on decrypt failure (src/lib/crypto/sk-recovery.ts). Outbox for offline retry (src/lib/crypto/outbox.ts). Supabase Auth is banned.
architectural_locks.encryption: Signal Protocol via libsodium-wrappers-sumo. XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD. Ed25519 signing. Curve25519 DH. HKDF-SHA-256. Argon2id backups. Three-layer architecture: L1 (key management), L2 (message encryption, zero-knowledge), L3 (structured intelligence). Server never sees plaintext or private keys. Encrypted IndexedDB store replaces plaintext keystore. Two-phase ratchet commit for crash safety. Decrypt mutex serializes decryption to prevent ratchet brick. Full spec: SECURITY.md.
architectural_locks.e2ee_absolute_law: NEVER BYPASS E2EE. Not for solo spaces, not for testing, not for convenience, not for any reason. Solo spaces encrypt to self. If encryption fails, message does not send. If a feature conflicts with E2EE, the feature does not ship. Plaintext write paths are FORBIDDEN. This rule has no exceptions.
